claims: Barnwell County, South Carolina, was established in 1798
Barnwell County is located in the Central Savannah River Area
Barnwell County is a rural county
Barnwell County has a population of approximately 20,589
Barnwell County has a 71% homeownership rate
Barnwell County has a median property value of $97,200
The county seat of Barnwell County is the city of Barnwell
Barnwell County is situated on the Coastal Plain
Barnwell County is bordered by the Savannah River
Barnwell County is bordered by the South Fork Edisto River
Municipalities in Barnwell County include the city of Barnwell, Blackville, and Williston
Major manufacturing companies in the Barnwell County area include Swiss Krono, Augusta Fiberglass Coatings, Inc., and Dayco
Attractions in Barnwell County include Barnwell State Park, God's Acre Healing Springs, and Lake Brown
The Barnwell Ring is a group of 20th-century state politicians including Senator Edgar A. Brown, Speaker of the House Solomon Blatt, and Governor Joseph E. Harley
Barnwell County has a roughly 2.39% foreign-born population
Barnwell County's median commute is 27.5 minutes
